description: This PHP script manages the administrative settings for SugarFeed in SuiteCRM, including enabling/disabling feeds, processing form submissions, and rendering the admin settings interface.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering the admin interface.

methods.name: retrieveSettings
methods.description: Retrieves the current settings for the admin configuration.

methods.name: saveSetting
methods.description: Saves a specific setting value for a module.

methods.name: getAllFeedModules
methods.description: Returns a list of all modules that have SugarFeed enabled.

methods.name: flushBackendCache
methods.description: Clears the backend cache for SugarFeed.
